says: In next/, the P42 slice 1 law L11 (every storage read and write in the child and lifecycle flows keeps error text and metadata out of outputs) hit its 60 s timeout during a vitest --changed origin/main run at --maxWorkers=3, and passes when its file runs alone, so it fails by load and not by code.
proof: At 38cb1ad on fabrikalfa/mock-transport-s1, nice -n 15 pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=3 --changed origin/main: 85 of 86 files passed and L11 failed at 60018 ms. The same file then run alone at --maxWorkers=1 passed 23 of 23. The slice changed only transport files, none of which L11 asserts on.
cost: A --changed run or a scheduled run that takes this file with other workerd files can go red with no fault, which costs a rerun and a look each time.
head: 38cb1ad
